onScreen.idle: Diana at rest after the victory stop, and rising out of the soil on the wake
onScreen.bodyDash: no-cape body under the flight cape
onScreen.startStop: wake / respawn start and the victory stop
onScreen.sprout: title sprout (Diana hidden in the soil), the leaves that twitch as she emerges, and the respawn pop
onScreen.star: pickups, constellations, Great Stars, HUD slots, beacon tops, death shards, refill bursts
onScreen.titleground: title ground and tinted back hills
onScreen.tailStar: updraft wind streaks and Great Star tails
onScreen.sound: every effect is synthesised in audio.mjs (D major, the soundtrack key); no sample files are loaded
onScreen.nocapeRun: Diana running before the cape is hers (a level whose verbs lack the cape)
onScreen.nocapeIdle: no-cape rest and the no-cape emergence from the soil
onScreen.nocapeDrop: no-cape dive roll (only if a level grants the dive before the cape)
onScreen.nocapeStartStop: no-cape wake / respawn start and victory stop
onScreen.breathDisc: HUD breath bar: the disc at the bar's left end while the cape is charging
onScreen.breathFrame: HUD breath bar: the hand-drawn frame
onScreen.breathFill: HUD breath bar: the fill, clipped to the cape's charge
onScreen.meteor: HUD breath bar: the disc once the cape is full (the gift is ready), with one ring pulse

archiveOnly.title: fulltitle composition; the title is rebuilt from its own logo and ground layers so the sprout can animate
archiveOnly.jump-landing.png: byte-identical duplicate of jumpLanding.png left by an earlier pass; not referenced and excluded from the itch ZIP
archiveOnly.sfx: assets/sfx/*.wav (Jump, Dash, star, death, successLevel, select): kept for provenance; replaced by procedural cues and excluded from the itch ZIP
archiveOnly.No Cape/running.anim: a stray copy of nocape-running.anim in the sprite folder (not referenced by the override controller); not extracted

meaningsNotUsed.meteor: In the original HUD the full meteor marked the star quota (a flight cost collected stars). Here it only means "the cape is full"; stars never gate a flight (RESEARCH_PROGRESSION 3.1, C4)
meaningsNotUsed.breathDisc: DianaCooldownCircle was the original cooldown timer disc; the bar now fills by running (breath), not by a timer
